coverage.name: Grand County
limitations: No Grand County ballot issue or question appears on any style; the county section lists candidates only.

Excluded (special districts, not housing): Grand County Library District 6B (0.95-mill levy extended without expiration) and 6C (5.25% limit waiver); West Grand School District 1-JT 5A (school debt); Hot Sulphur Springs-Parshall Fire Protection District 6A (5.25% limit waiver); East Grand County Fire Protection District No. 4 6D (fire sales tax) and 6E (5.25% limit waiver).
